title: CAT 2026 Admit Card: Check release date, instructions and how to download - Business Standard
text:

 Home / Education / News / CAT 2026 Admit Card: Check release date, instructions and how to download CAT 2026 Admit Card: Check release date, instructions and how to download
 The CAT 2026 admit card release date has been notified; the hall ticket will be made available on Nov 4, 2026. Once out, aspirants can download it from the official website at iimcat.ac.in
 CAT 2026 exam
 Princess Sonika New Delhi 2 min read Last Updated : Oct 27 2026 | 5:29 PM IST Listen to This Article
 On November 4, 2026, the Common Admission Test (CAT) admit card will be made available by the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Indore. Those who successfully registered for the exam can receive their hall ticket from the official website, iimcat.ac.in, after it is released.   There will be three sessions for the CAT exam on November 29, 2026. The first session will run from 8:30 am to 10:30 am; the second session will run from 12:30 pm to 2:30 pm; and the third session will run from 4:30 pm to 6:30 pm. CAT 2026 Admit Card: Know how to download?
 Step 1: Visit the official website at iimcat.ac.in     Step 2: On the homepage, click the registered candidate login link.   Step 3: Now fill in the registered user ID and password. Also Read

   Step 4: Once you submit the login details, the CAT 2026 Admit Card will be displayed on the screen.   Step 5: Download the PDF and save it for later use.   ALSO READ:  India Post GDS 2nd merit list 2026 soon: Expected date and how to check CAT 2026 exam and marking pattern
 Three sections will make up the 120-minute exam: Section I: Reading Comprehension and Verbal Ability, Section II: Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning, Section III: Quantitative Ability.   Candidates will receive three points for each correct response, one point for a wrong multiple-choice question, and zero points for unanswered or unattempted questions. Additional about the CAT 2026 exam
 Candidates can use their registered user ID and password to access their hall tickets once the exam-conducting agency releases them.   To prevent inconvenience during the exam, candidates should carefully read the instructions on their admit card.   ALSO READ:  CBSE National Summit 2026: Focus on skills, careers and employability   More From This Section
